purpose: Direct Windows KD read of LPASS WSA macro MMIO
host: SP7 classic kd.exe via PiMaster ConPTY

result.recovery: SP11 automatically rebooted into saved Linux CPS-v3 fallback

safety_conclusion: APPS/KD direct physical reads of the 0x06b00000 LPASS WSA macro aperture are unsafe even with [uc]. Do not issue !dd, dd, !db, or equivalent direct physical reads against this aperture again, regardless of target uptime or audio state.
scope: This does not invalidate KDNET itself. Direct kd.exe ConPTY control is proven and remains suitable for host-driver breakpoints, register/memory observation in normal kernel virtual memory, and already-proven qcaucd/qcadcm tracing that does not access the WSA macro physical aperture.
connectivity_discriminator: SP7 and MacBook stayed online; SP11 alone faulted, proving this event was target-local and not the home router/provider.
